name: Yagami Shiina
source:
Shiina is the daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c59422]Misako[/url] and her previous husband. She have moved in to [url=https://vndb.org/c60747]Yuusuke[/url]'s home together with Misako after her mother's new marriage. She is a kind step-sister and a pure girl who has never known mistrust. Because she has nobody to look up to as a fatherly figure in her life, she constantly seeks an older male who can act that role for her. Somewhat inevitably, she'll develop a girlish kind of crush on her new step-brother. Depending on Yuusuke's choices, their relationship could grow into something more than just that of a simple brother and sister.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/921736-gibo-stepmothers-sin/faqs/31321]Geo's Walkthrough[/url]]
